integrationPlan.target: Original companion entity framework; Tracker remains distinct
tasks: The ten supplied companion designs stay original-project creatures; no implicit canon Tracker hound assignment.
Use accepted transparent cutouts with measured foot anchors.
Build deterministic terrestrial companion state: announced entry, one entity, readable attack, vulnerability, recall/cooldown and owner-KO cleanup.
Actual Tracker movie hound requires a separate sourced design and animation work; existing drone cannot stand in.
Keep PredDog identity separate even if it shares low-level state machinery.
Test orientation, floor anchoring, range/guard, one bite per attack, recall/owner KO, transitions, serialization and replays.
blockedOn: Native idle/run/bite/hit/recall/down drawings absent in this pack.

tasks: Give PredDog a distinct data identity and portrait from Tracker hound.
Preserve source filename and user attribution; do not infer owner from visual resemblance.
Use same companion state-machine framework only as shared mechanics, never same skin identity; assign actual role after source/scene choice.
Validate floor anchors and mirrored anatomy; native animation clips absent.
Create a separate enemy identity using exact source label, mark appearance as user design pending canon check.
Keep insectoid body rig distinct from Yautja and quadrupeds.
Add an explicit authored encounter and bestiary/codex reference; do not inject randomly into established film scenes.
Provide real hitboxes, locomotion/attack states, hit/defeat behavior and trophy rules before calling playable enemy finished.
Produce/validate transparent body and required animation drawings; existing one-pose portrait is not an attack sheet.
Retain original source labels and separate provenance; no renamed canon hunter or cosmetic alias without user instruction.
Use explicit original-project continuity, separate selectable identity only when actual movement/combat assets and controls are ready.
No unsupported weapons, clan, biography or supernatural power inferred from appearance.
Preserve static presentation state and disclosure until native clips/floor anchors/hitboxes validated.
Import as ten separate original designs with exact source filenames, not animation frames or canonical Tracker variants.
Assign original-project or uncertain status; no invented canonical aliases.
Prioritize individual rig and silhouette checks, then explicit companion/enemy role and encounter before activation.
Keep as provenance/reference only until identity and rights/source are clarified; no automatic roster duplication.
